newsitem.title: USA: Hirsch Intl acquires Sedeco of Texas.
newsitem.headline: Hirsch Intl acquires Sedeco of Texas.

text.p: Hirsch International Corp said Tuesday it has bought Sedeco Inc, a Texas distributor of embroidery machines, for about $6.6 million.
Sedeco reported revenues of about $11.7 million for the year ended October 31, 1996. Hirsch reported net sales of about $88 million for the first three quarters of 1996.
Hirsch said its primary supplier is Tajima Industries Ltd and that Sedeco holds the exclusive rights to distribute Tajima machines in Texas, Colorado, New Mexico, Louisiana, Arkansas and Oklahoma.

"With this acquisition and the expansion of our territory for one to six head machines to the West Coast, Hirsch now has the exclusive right to distribute Tajima small machines in the entire United States," the company said in a release.
